title: Marzahn Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Built fast:** site works began on 3 March 1975 and the first block was topped out on 2 September 1977.
**Its own district from 5 January 1979.** Hellersdorf split off in 1986 and the two merged again in 2001.
**About 100,000 flats** in the large estate, mostly from the WBS 70 panel series.
**Alt-Marzahn survived inside it:** a village church dedicated in 1871 and a post mill, about twenty minutes on foot from S Marzahn.
**Next to Parkfriedhof Marzahn** stood the Nazi forced camp for Sinti and Roma from 1936. A memorial stone has stood there since 1986.
**Gärten der Welt:** EUR 4 for adults from 1 November to 28 February, open daily from 9:00 until dusk.
**The Kienberg and the Wolkenhain platform are free** and give the best view of the estate.
**Easy day:** S7 out to S Marzahn, U5 back from U Kienberg. An AB ticket covers it.
